description_en:
You aren't on anyone's team until one side is about to lose, and then you join that side. You only win if you haven't been eliminated at the end of the game. (She switches teams when a team is about to lose so if the last werewolf dies she becomes a werewolf immediately, or if the werewolves achieve parity she becomes a villager. Basically prolongs the game a little bit longer. And she wins reagardless of her team winning as long as she's alive.

Also Ted plays that the village doesn't all die the game just ends. It's the only way to make Kimb work properly and Tom Vasel for that matter.)

description_en: The Magician gets to use a different nighttime power each night. Here's how it works: Before the game, the Moderator puts several nighttime-active roles in a pile (while he may reveal those roles to the players, it's better if he doesn't), and then each night, including the first night, he shows one of those cards to the magician, who may then use that special power. If he shows the Magician the Seer (this can happen because all you Kickstarter backers have at least one extra Seer), the Magician points to a player and learns if he is a werewolf. If he's shown the Insomniac, he'll be told if a player on either side of him woke up that night. If he's shown the Leprechaun, he can retarget who the werewolves selected. It's a fun, dynamic and exciting role that can really help the village!
tooltip_en: The Magician gets to use a different nighttime power each night. If he shows the Magician the Seer (this can happen because all you Kickstarter backers have at least one extra Seer), the Magician points to a player and learns if he is a werewolf. If he's shown the Insomniac, he'll be told if a player on either side of him woke up that night. If he's shown the Leprechaun, he can retarget who the werewolves selected. It's a fun, dynamic and exciting role that can really help the village!

tooltip_en: A Village role with a special voting behavior that can affect how votes are resolved.

tooltip_en: A role with special potions that may save a player and/or eliminate a player, depending on the ruleset.
description_id: Memiliki 2 ramuan: Ramuan Penyembuh (menyelamatkan korban serangan Werewolf) dan Ramuan Racun (mengeliminasi 1 pemain pilihan di malam hari).
tooltip_id: Memiliki 2 ramuan: Ramuan Penyembuh (menyelamatkan korban serangan Werewolf) dan Ramuan Racun (mengeliminasi 1 pemain pilihan di malam hari).

description_en: Each night, wake with the Werewolves. If you are eliminated, the Werewolves eliminate two players the following night.
tooltip_en: Each night, wake with the Werewolves. If you are eliminated, the Werewolves eliminate two players the following night.
description_id: Anak serigala. Jika Wolf Cub dieliminasi, para Werewolf akan mengamuk dan boleh mengeliminasi dua pemain pada malam berikutnya.
tooltip_id: Anak serigala. Jika Wolf Cub dieliminasi, para Werewolf akan mengamuk dan boleh mengeliminasi dua pemain pada malam berikutnya.

description_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. If you are still in the game, the Werewolves may eliminate two adjacent players.
tooltip_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. If you are still in the game, the Werewolves may eliminate two adjacent players.
description_id: Selama Big Bad Wolf masih hidup, Werewolf dapat mengeliminasi dua pemain yang duduk bersebelahan setiap malam.
tooltip_id: Selama Big Bad Wolf masih hidup, Werewolf dapat mengeliminasi dua pemain yang duduk bersebelahan setiap malam.

description_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. The first night, choose a player to be your companion. You are eliminated if that player is eliminated.
tooltip_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. The first night, choose a player to be your companion. You are eliminated if that player is eliminated.

tooltip_id: Bangun bersama Werewolf. Pada malam pertama, pilih seorang pemain sebagai sahabat karibmu. Jika dia mati, kamu ikut mati seketika.

tooltip_en: The first night, wake with the other Werewolves. While there are other Werewolves in the game, do not wake up with them on subsequent nights.
description_id: Pada malam pertama bangun bersama Werewolf. Setelah itu, tidak bangun lagi bersama Werewolf selama masih ada Werewolf lain yang hidup.
tooltip_id: Pada malam pertama bangun bersama Werewolf. Setelah itu, tidak bangun lagi bersama Werewolf selama masih ada Werewolf lain yang hidup.

tooltip_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. If you are the last Werewolf in the game, you do not get to eliminate a player at night.
description_id: Bangun bersama Werewolf. Namun jika kamu menjadi Werewolf terakhir yang tersisa, kamu tidak bisa mengeliminasi pemain di malam hari.
tooltip_id: Bangun bersama Werewolf. Namun jika kamu menjadi Werewolf terakhir yang tersisa, kamu tidak bisa mengeliminasi pemain di malam hari.

tooltip_en: The first night, choose a player to be afraid of you. If you are eliminated, that player is also eliminated.
description_id: Pada malam pertama, pilih seorang pemain yang takut padamu. Jika kamu dieliminasi, pemain tersebut juga akan ikut dieliminasi.

tooltip_en: Each night, wake with the other Werewolves. If you are the closest Werewolf to the target, the players hear a metallic sound.

tooltip_en: Each night, pick a player to be a wife. If you make it through a day/night cycle with 3 wives, you win.
description_id: Setiap malam, pilih seorang pemain untuk dijadikan istri. Jika berhasil bertahan satu siklus siang/malam dengan 3 istri hidup, kamu menang!
tooltip_id: Setiap malam, pilih seorang pemain untuk dijadikan istri. Jika berhasil bertahan satu siklus siang/malam dengan 3 istri hidup, kamu menang!

tooltip_en: Whenever a special character dies, you get their power

tooltip_id: Setiap kali ada karakter dengan peran khusus yang mati, kamu menyerap dan mendapatkan kekuatan khusus mereka.

tooltip_en: Wake with the other werewolves. You must say "werewolf" at least once per day.

tooltip_id: Bangun bersama Werewolf setiap malam. Kamu wajib mengucapkan kata 'werewolf' setidaknya satu kali setiap fase siang.

tooltip_en: Each night, the player to the right of The Blob is absorbed. If all players are part of The Blob, you win.

tooltip_id: Setiap malam, pemain yang duduk di sebelah kanan The Blob akan diserap. Jika semua pemain terserap ke dalam The Blob, kamu menang!

tooltip_en: Each night, pick a player to be hypnotized. That player will vote the way you do.

tooltip_en: Each night, pick a player and eat their brains. That player may no longer vote.
description_id: Setiap malam, pilih seorang pemain dan makan otaknya. Pemain tersebut kehilangan kemampuan untuk memberikan suara (vote).
tooltip_id: Setiap malam, pilih seorang pemain dan makan otaknya. Pemain tersebut kehilangan kemampuan untuk memberikan suara (vote).

tooltip_id: Pada malam pertama, Beholder membuka mata dan mengetahui siapa pemain yang menjadi Seer di desa.

tooltip_en: If the Werewolves don't agree on a target quickly, you choose a target. You win if all the night-active players are dead.

tooltip_id: Jika Werewolf tidak segera menyepakati target di malam hari, Bogeyman yang menentukan targetnya. Menang jika semua role beraksi malam mati.

tooltip_en: You don't wake at night with the other Werewolves until after a Werewolf is killed.

tooltip_id: Werewolf yang tertidur. Kamu tidak bangun bersama Werewolf lain di malam hari sampai ada satu Werewolf yang mati tereliminasi.

tooltip_en: Each night, learn if at least one of your neighbors has woken up during the night.

tooltip_en: The first night you are told how many Werewolves are in each half of the village.

tooltip_id: Pada malam pertama, The Count diberi tahu berapa jumlah Werewolf yang berada di sisi kiri dan sisi kanan desa.

description_en: Each night, tap a player sitting immediately next to you.
tooltip_en: Each night, tap a player sitting immediately next to you.
description_id: Setiap malam, tepuk pundak pemain yang duduk tepat di sebelahmu untuk memberi tanda rahasia.
tooltip_id: Setiap malam, tepuk pundak pemain yang duduk tepat di sebelahmu untuk memberi tanda rahasia.

tooltip_en: If you die, each night kill either a Villager if you were lynched or a Werewolf if you were attacked.
description_id: Jika kamu mati digantung warga, setiap malam kamu membunuh satu Villager. Jika kamu mati diserang Werewolf, setiap malam kamu membunuh satu Werewolf.
tooltip_id: Jika kamu mati digantung warga, setiap malam kamu membunuh satu Villager. Jika kamu mati diserang Werewolf, setiap malam kamu membunuh satu Werewolf.
